description: The declared price table evals multiply tokens by. Local inference (ollama) has no per-token price: its entries are 0 and the report says so. A paid provider's price is never invented here: a null price means 'unknown', the run still happens and the cost column reads 'unknown'.

entries.note: local inference: no marginal cost; hardware and electricity are not accounted
paid provider: paste its published per-1M price here before trusting the cost column; null means unknown, never zero
